controls.breaker_class: 3 same-class failures halts the wave and escalates
controls.idempotency: every converted stage is re-runnable: bronze is file-level exactly-once on a processed-file ledger, silver is a deterministic function of bronze, gold is a full recompute of silver. Idempotency is proven by an actual second run, never asserted
controls.namespace_isolation: a batch writes only its declared write_targets plus its declared runtime_writes; DDL for a table belongs to exactly one unit
controls.fixture_vs_live: develop against the legacy fixture set (make legacy-etl-gen-data / legacy-etl-run), then exactly one merge-evidence recon run per unit; a fixture PASS is never merge evidence
controls.fanout: serial by construction - the CUSTBILL chain is four dependency-ordered stages, so every wave is a single batch. run_workflow is not used: it exists for waves with more than one batch, and a one-child workflow would only re-import pipeline 1's runner-environment failure for no parallelism. The manifest keeps the fan-out shape so the collision check, the breaker and the wave close still apply

batches.brief:
BATCH p2-w1-a - wave 1 of the OtterWorks pipeline-2 migration.

UNITS
  - p2-sftp-ingest: etl/legacy-extra/jobs/sftp_ingest_poll.ksh (70 lines) -> governed landing
    + ow_tp.bronze.custbill_raw.

WHAT THIS BATCH IS
Replace the SFTP poll with a governed landing path and a bronze streaming table. One bronze
row per physical record, raw bytes preserved (contract C-1.3, C-1.4: read binary, slice by
byte, decode ISO-8859-1 so every byte round-trips).

Traps:
 - the 1-second double-stat stability check is not a stability guarantee. Replace it with an
   atomic land (staging name + rename), which REMOVES the half-written-file race. That is
   decision P2-D01, approved at STOP C - not a silent fix;
 - the legacy copies to incoming/ AND archive/ and then rm's the drop file, swallowing every
   failure with `|| true`. A file can be deleted after a failed copy. The target never
   deletes the source; it records the file in ow_tp.bronze.custbill_files;
 - /tmp/sftp_ingest.lock is created and never removed. Dropped, not reproduced;
 - transitive write: parse renames the input to .done, which is a write into THIS unit's
   output directory. The file ledger is declared as a write target of the parse unit for
   exactly that reason.

RECON
  python3 databricks/migration/recon/with_databricks_sql_token.py DATABRICKS_MIGRATION_SQL -- \
  python3 -m recon.cli run --unit p2-sftp-ingest --family databricks \
    --mapping .migration/units/p2-sftp-ingest/mapping_spec.json \
    --tolerances .migration/03_recon_tolerances.json \
    --canonicalization databricks/migration/p2/recon/canonicalization.files.json \
    --mode live --source-dsn-secret DATABRICKS_MIGRATION_SQL \
    --target-kind databricks --target-secret DATABRICKS_MIGRATION_SQL \
    --target-catalog ow_tp --target-schema bronze \
    --allowed-targets-file .migration/allowed_targets.json \
    --seed 0 --depth full --out .migration/recon/p2-sftp-ingest/

READ FIRST (committed on the base branch)
  .migration/00_context.md, 01_conventions.md, 03_recon_tolerances.{md,json},
  04_dependency_register.md, 06_decisions.md, allowed_targets.json
  docs/migration/Pipeline2_custbill_plan.md            (this plan: scope, waves, gate)
  docs/migration/Pipeline2_custbill_record_contract.md (the behavioural contract, clause ids)
  docs/migration/Pipeline2_schedule_model.md           (cron -> Lakeflow Job model)
  docs/migration/OtterWorks_target_state.md            (target layout and conventions)

SOURCE (read-only)
  Legacy files under etl/legacy-extra/. The legacy scripts are never modified. The recon
  source side is their own captured output, loaded verbatim into
  ow_tp.bronze.custbill_legacy_baseline_*; the target side recomputes from the raw .dat
  inputs and never reads those baseline tables.

TARGETS
  Unity Catalog ow_tp (bronze/silver/gold), volumes under /Volumes/ow_tp/, jobs and
  pipelines named ow_tp_p2_*, secret scope ow_tp. Warehouse 565cd2fd713738c4.
  Never create a cluster. Every schedule lands PAUSED.
  The guard (hooks/dbx_guard.py) blocks anything outside .migration/allowed_targets.json.
  A block is a finding to report, never something to route around.

behaviour_changes.change: The legacy can parse a half-written file (1-second double-stat, parse 5 minutes later). The target lands atomically and sequences parse as a dependency edge, so it cannot.
behaviour_changes.why_untestable: Requires racing a producer mid-write; pinned fixtures cannot exercise it.

behaviour_changes.change: The target never deletes source files, writes no /tmp lock files, and fails loudly where the legacy stages end in '|| true'.
sendmail is dropped; the Lakeflow Job's failure notification replaces it.

invariants.gold_completeness: Gold contains every record the legacy chain produced, byte for byte, including the corrupt ones. Quarantine is an additional observability table and is NEVER a gate on the output (contract C-6.3).
invariants.on_violation: If any expectation would drop a record from gold, the unit HALTS and reports to the parent. It is never reconciled around.
